classification: The 0.4.18 core OS is stable and the powered hub routes at full speed, but the attempted Kconfig recovery targeted the wrong failure boundary. espressif/usb uses CONFIG_USB_HOST_EXT_PORT_RESET_ATTEMPTS when a downstream port reset itself fails; a CHECK_SHORT_DEV_DESC enumeration failure instead disables the already-enabled port and saturates that counter. The attached low-speed child therefore received no enumeration retry.
corrective_action: Keep the pinned USB component and full-speed root policy. Add a bounded platform-owned host/hub recycle after an initial no-HID enumeration window, or a narrowly scoped reviewed enumeration retry above the managed component, then issue a new exact-artifact authorization. Do not claim controller acceptance from this build.
